# Results (auto-generated by `python -m beliefview.cli test`)

Synthetic 2D simulation. N = 100 held-out test episodes per scenario, paired across policies. Deadline T = 80 steps. Config hash `222bce7e37097894`. Intervals are 95% percentile bootstrap over episodes (B=2000).

**What is paired.** Every policy runs the same pre-rolled episodes: identical subject trajectory, behaviour, observer start, noisy last-seen measurement and its age, deadline, sensor, look gate and controller. The detection uniform `u[t]` and the measurement noise are pre-drawn per time step and shared (common random numbers). A detection at step t happens when that step is a new look and `u[t] < P(detect | this policy's viewpoint)`, so policies at different viewpoints do **not** receive identical observations; only the draws are shared. The simulated sensor has no false positives.

## Primary comparison: clean no-miss-update ablation

BeliefView and the ablation use the same planner settings object (candidate set, horizon 12, commit 3, travel penalty lam = 0), the same controller and the same episodes. The only difference is whether a missed detection updates the belief. Differences are BeliefView minus ablation: `d_found` > 0 means miss updates helped; `d_rmst` < 0 means faster; distance is over all episodes (flown until first detection or the deadline).

| scenario | BeliefView reacquired | ablation reacquired | d_found [95% CI] | d_rmst [95% CI] | d_distance [95% CI] | both found | only BeliefView | only ablation | neither |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| A_matched | 0.55 | 0.48 | +0.070 [+0.010, +0.130] | -4.3 [-8.0, -0.8] | +6.3 [+2.4, +10.3] | 46 | 9 | 2 | 43 |
| B_motion_mismatch | 0.75 | 0.69 | +0.060 [+0.020, +0.110] | -3.1 [-5.7, -0.9] | +3.5 [+0.9, +6.2] | 69 | 6 | 0 | 25 |
| C_sensor_mismatch | 0.53 | 0.50 | +0.030 [-0.050, +0.110] | -1.6 [-6.4, +3.2] | +9.3 [+4.2, +13.9] | 44 | 9 | 6 | 41 |
| D_exit_mismatch | 0.48 | 0.46 | +0.020 [-0.030, +0.070] | -1.2 [-3.9, +1.4] | +11.2 [+7.9, +14.5] | 44 | 4 | 2 | 50 |
